 Veterans Day ceremony and parade Nov. 11
 October 29, 2026 
 by YourArlington staff 
 Veterans Day is soon approaching on Wednesday, Nov. 11, and the town is inviting community members to Arlington’s annual Veterans Day parade and ceremony. 
 Each year, the parade participants gather at the Walgreens Pharmacy (324 Mass. Ave.) on the morning of Veterans Day. This year, the town is asking attendees to meet at 10:15 a.m., with the parade scheduled to begin at 10:30 a.m.
 The group will proceed to the Central Fire Station, escorted by the Arlington Police Department and the Council on Aging, for those with mobility challenges. 
 The Veterans Day ceremony will be held at the fire station, followed by a wreath-laying observance as the town’s Veterans Memorial Monument (309 Broadway).
 This announcement, published Oct. 29, 2026, used information provided by the town. YourArlington has covered the status of the Veterans Memorial Park renovation separately. 
 The town invites the community to return to the fire station following the observance for coffee and donuts. The event is scheduled to conclude at 12:30 p.m. 
 “This year’s gathering also offers an opportunity to learn more about the Veterans Memorial Park renovation project,” the town wrote in its announcement.
 Many in town have been long awaiting the memorial’s updates, now projected to start in 2027 .
 The most recent update from the town in regards to this project was a call for community help in collecting names to be engraved on the ‘Veterans Honor Roll.’
 “The renovated park will provide a welcoming place for veterans, families, and neighbors to remember those lives, reflect on their sacrifices, and connect with Arlington’s enduring legacy of service,” the town wrote.
 Additional updates and information on the Veterans Memorial Park renovation project are available here.
